9001.text_en: Loves matcha and uses a bamboo whisk
9001.text_fr: Adore le matcha et utilise un fouet en bambou
9001.quote: I am completely addicted to matcha now, I make one every morning with the bamboo whisk I brought back.

9001.text_en: Wants to try a pottery wheel class
9001.text_fr: Veut essayer un cours de tour de poterie
9001.quote: I have been dying to try a pottery wheel class ever since.
9001.experience_query: pottery wheel class near her place

9001.quote: And do not forget my birthday this year, it is on October 31, so maybe brunch?

9001.text_en: Brunch for her birthday on October 31
9001.text_fr: Brunch pour son anniversaire le 31 octobre
9001.quote: And do not forget my birthday this year, it is on October 31, so maybe brunch?

9001.text_en: Send her the pottery studio link
9001.text_fr: Lui envoyer le lien de l'atelier de poterie
9001.quote: There is a studio near your place, I will send you the link tomorrow.

9002.text_en: Loves old Blue Note jazz records
9002.text_fr: Aime les vieux disques Blue Note de jazz
9002.quote: I love it. Now I am hunting for old Blue Note jazz records, the original pressings.
My first half-marathon is on Sunday, twenty-one kilometres, I am terrified.
Let us do dinner on Wednesday to celebrate. I will book that ramen place on Court Street.

9002.text_en: Book ramen place on Court Street
9002.text_fr: Réserver le restaurant ramen de Court Street
9002.quote: I will book that ramen place on Court Street.

9003.text_en: Misses her classical music due to broken radio
9003.text_fr: Elle manque sa musique classique à cause de sa radio cassée
9003.quote: Non, elle grésille, je n'entends plus ma musique classique le matin, ça me manque beaucoup.

9003.text_en: Will bring her the garden photo album on Sunday
9003.text_fr: Je t'apporte l'album photo du jardin dimanche prochain, promis.
9003.quote: Je t'apporte l'album photo du jardin dimanche prochain, promis.

9005.text_en: Climbing twice a week at bouldering gym
9005.text_fr: Grimpe deux fois par semaine au gymnase de bouldering
9005.quote: I have also been climbing twice a week at the bouldering gym.

9005.text_en: Talk with in-laws in Valencia by next summer
9005.text_fr: Parler avec ses beaux-parents à Valence d'ici l'été prochain
9005.quote: I want to talk with my in-laws in Valencia by next summer.

9005.text_en: Lend him my Spanish podcast list
9005.text_fr: Lui prêter ma liste de podcasts d'espagnol
9005.quote: I will lend you my Spanish podcast list.

facts.text_en: Loved the ceramics studios in Kyoto
facts.text_fr: A adoré les studios de céramique à Kyoto
facts.quote: Sam's sister Maya recently travelled to Kyoto and loved its ceramics studios.
